svg.title: Jobs within 60 minutes by public transport, Rio de Janeiro
svg.desc: A map of the municipality of Rio de Janeiro covered by cells coloured by the share of the city's formal jobs reached within 60 minutes by walking and public transport (buses and BRT; the feed has no rail) at the morning peak. The centre and the neighbourhoods around it reach the most; the west reaches the least. Half the residents reach 20.9% of the jobs or less.

g.text: Share of the municipality's 1,580,698 formal jobs reached from each cell,
walking and riding, at the morning peak (median of departures 07:00–07:59,
Tuesday 17 November 2026). Half the residents reach 20.9% or less.
Blank: cells without residents. Buses and BRT only: the feed has no metro, train, VLT or ferry
Jobs within an hour by public transport, Rio de Janeiro
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). GTFS: SMTR, Prefeitura do Rio de Janeiro, 10 June 2026 (CC BY 4.0). Cells, population
(Censo 2010) and jobs (RAIS 2019): Ipea, Access to Opportunities Project (aopdata).
